sources.title: GitHub - kevinharden/stm32ai-modelzoo-for-me: AI Model Zoo for STM32 ...
sources.snippet: The STM32 AI model zoo is a collection of reference machine learning models that are optimized to run on STM32 microcontrollers. Available on GitHub, this is a valuable resource for anyone looking to add AI capabilities to their STM32-based projects.
